js: (() => { const G = window.G; if (G.player.car) G.toggleCar(); dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { code: 'KeyH', key: 'h' })); return JSON.stringify({ offen: G.PHONE.isOpen, apps: G.PHONE.apps }); })()
(() => { dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { code: 'KeyH', key: 'h' })); return String(window.G.PHONE.isOpen); })()

(() => { const P = window.G.PHONE, err = []; window.G.DEMO.sub('Kim', 'Probe-Nachricht', 2); for (const id of P.apps.filter(a => a !== 'karte' && a !== 'kamera')) { P.open(); if (!P.openApp(id)) err.push(id + ':nicht da'); const pg = document.querySelector('#phone .ps-phone__page'); if (!pg || /nicht verfügbar/.test(pg.textContent)) err.push(id); P.close(); } P.open(); P.openApp('kamera'); P.close(); return JSON.stringify({ fehler: err, msgs: P.msgs.length }); })()
(() => { const P = window.G.PHONE; P.open(); P.openApp('nachrichten'); return document.querySelector('#phone .ps-phone__page').textContent.slice(0, 200); })()
(() => { const P = window.G.PHONE; P.close(); P.open(); P.openApp('missionen'); return document.querySelector('#phone .ps-phone__page').textContent.slice(0, 300); })()

(async () => { const G = window.G, w = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); let n = 0; for (; n < 12 && !G.LAUF.run; n++) { G.PHONE.close(); await w(2000); G.PHONE.open(); G.PHONE.openApp('missionen'); await w(400); const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('#phone .ps-pbtn')].find(x => /Laufrunde starten/.test(x.textContent)); if (b) b.click(); await w(800); } return JSON.stringify({ laeuft: !!G.LAUF.run, versuche: n, handy: G.PHONE.isOpen }); })()
(() => { const P = window.G.PHONE; P.open(); P.openApp('karte'); return JSON.stringify({ menu: document.getElementById('menu').style.display }); })()
(() => { window.G.X.closeMenu(); dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { code: 'Escape', key: 'Escape' })); return document.getElementById('menu').style.display; })()
(() => { window.G.X.closeMenu(); dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { code: 'F1', key: 'F1' })); return 'ok'; })()
